messages:
sarah-ops: Alert: Datadog spike on prod-db-01 read QPS starting ~03:12 UTC. Two service accounts showing abnormal activity: svc-ak-prod and svc-batch. Suspect leaked creds or misconfigured job. Opening war-room.
incident-bot: Datadog alert: metric_threshold.prod_db.read_qps (https://app.datadog.example/alert/9876)
elaine-sre: Acknowledged. Can someone check DB connection logs + client IPs? I'll pull recent host metrics.
mike-sec: On it. Querying audit logs for service account auth events. Also checking KMS access logs — want to know if any keywrap/unseal happened.
raj-engr: I'm looking at the job scheduler history (cron-runner). svc-batch ran a heavy job at 03:10, but svc-ak-prod is used by the API. Getting last 50 DB sessions now.
elaine-sre: DB sessions: several long-running read queries from two IPs that don't match our known egress ranges. Marking as suspicious. Saving pcap and connection metadata.

mike-sec: Quick containment plan:
  1) Revoke both service-account keys in IAM (short-term disable).
  2) Rotate DB credentials and push new creds via Vault.
  3) Add temporary DB firewall rule to block the two external IPs.
  4) Snapshot audit logs and escalate if exfil confirmed.

sarah-ops: Agree. Execute 1 and 3 asap. 2 should be coordinated so we don't break the API — consider a rolling credential swap.

raj-engr: Running commands now:
```
# list keys for svc-ak-prod
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-ak-prod@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# disable key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID
```

raj-engr: Disabled key for svc-ak-prod and disabled svc-batch key. Notified ops that API will fall back to secondary credentials if present — monitoring for errors.

elaine-sre: Applied DB firewall deny for the two IPs (x.x.x.101, y.y.y.202). Taking a short snapshot of DB state and performance metrics.

mike-sec: Collected KMS audit entries for the last 6 hours. No direct KMS decrypts from those external IPs, but there are API calls from the two service accounts that coincide with the spike. Pulling full logs to S3 for analysis.

sarah-ops: Good. Next: rotate DB creds in Vault. raj, can you prepare a migration runbook? Keep TTLs short; create fallback path.

raj-engr: Preparing runbook. Steps:
  - create new DB user creds
  - stage in Vault path secret/prod/db/new
  - update one replica service to use new creds
  - monitor for auth failures
  - roll out to remaining services

raj-engr: Starting staged rotation on a single replica now. Will wait 5m and monitor.

elaine-sre: No increase in 502/5xx from API after key disable. Read QPS dropped back to baseline. Looks like containment succeeded so far.

mike-sec: I'll continue forensic collection (auth logs, process lists, container images) and check for lateral movement. Also running a quick vuln scan on the job repo that svc-batch uses.

sarah-ops: Decision log: containment actions executed -> disabled compromised keys, applied IP deny, staged DB credential rotation. Forensics in progress. No customer data exfil confirmed yet.

mike-sec: Found one suspicious commit in batch job repo referencing a temporary env var that writes creds to stdout. Opening a PR to remove and adding a CI secret-scan rule.

sarah-ops: Good catch. Add remediation to post-incident actions: secret scanning policy, rotate all long-lived SA keys, reduce default key TTL, and add stricter KMS audit alerts.

elaine-sre: Preparing incident timeline and artifacts for handoff.

sarah-ops: Handoff to raj-engr for next shift. Summary for new on-call: containment done, keys disabled, DB creds staged for rotation, forensics artifacts in gs://redwood-incidents/1895123456/, follow-up actions: rotate all SA keys, add secret scanning, update runbook, legal review if exfil confirmed. Tag me if anything escalates.

raj-engr: Acknowledged. I'll take it from here and continue review + remediation. Leaving a short set of TODOs in the incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active response by sarah-ops -> handoff to raj-engr. Reference: incident-1895123456
sarah-ops: Thanks team :thumbsup:
note: This thread captures the open-to-handoff on-call coordination for a suspicious DB read spike tied to service account keys. Contains short commands, containment actions, and handoff summary.
